caseName: Boston Safe Deposit & Trust Co. v. Long
caseNameFull: Boston Safe Deposit & Trust Co., Trustee v. Long, Commissioner
attorneys: Mr. R. Ammi Cutter for appellant., Mr. Paul A. Dever, Attorney General of Massachusetts, and Mr. James J. Ronan for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion of the appellee to dismiss the appeal is granted, and the appeal is *519dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question. Saltonstall v. Saltonstall, 276 U. S. 260.

Mr. R. Ammi Cutter for appellant. Mr. Paul A. Dever, Attorney General of Massachusetts, and Mr. James J. Ronan for appellee.
